notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for all the support! Thanks to some awesome discord feedback, we've made a couple of changes that should smooth out your Sky Squadron experience.

We've added the ability to select the audio output device when using a VR headset. This should help with any issues with the audio not correctly being played through the headset. Check out the options screen to manually select which audio output device you want to use.

We've also tweaked the difficulty of easy mode. There should be far fewer damage spikes now!

Pew pew pew!

notes.title: Steamlink Hotfix!
notes.notes:
We had some issues with Sky Squadron not working when using the Steamlink app on Quest. We've fixed that issue. Just remember you'll need to set the appropriate OpenXR Runtime to SteamVR when using steam link, or Meta Quest Link when using Quest Link.

Any issues, please let us know!

notes.title: Road to Release!
notes.notes:
Oi mates!

It’s been a while since our last update, so we wanted to give a quick update on how things are going. We’re fast approaching content complete, with 10 missions, each with their own leaderboard, unique bosses and minibosses, and mission challenges to overcome (complete with ‘cheevos)! 

We’ll have plenty of new content available when we launch.

We were originally planning a release date at the end of the year, but we’ve decided to push it back until early next year while we finish and polish everything off. Also, I’m having a baby! (well not me personally, my wife is) so I’m going to be a bit occupied for a while.

But don’t worry! We’re getting very close to version 1.0, and super excited to get Sky Squadron released in the near future.

As always, any thoughts or feedback, please let us know!

Cheers,
James

notes.title: Update 0.44 - Challenges and Achievements
notes.notes:
Think you’ve aced that mission? Not yet, mate! We’ve got some extra challenges for you to complete in Mission 1, along with some tasty achievements to unlock.

What’s new:

 10 achievements to unlock (including some secrets!)
 4 mission challenges to overcome in Mission 1
 Various updates and fixes

The eggheads have been tinkerin’ with some new kit for you to test out - a lightning powerup! Jump into mission one and save Perry to check it out.

What’s new:

 New Chain Lightning Powerup to cut through those bad guys!
 Various bug fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Sky Squadron Update news
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for  checking out Sky Squadron! We are now back from a well earnt break and getting ready to make more content for you all to enjoy! With that, we’d also like to announce our plans for the next round of updates!

Update 01 - End of Episode Boss
Update 02 - Power ups!
Update 03 - Exciting New Game Mode!

We’ve blocked out a fair few ideas for further updates after these, but we thought we’d start with  these three first as they are great building blocks to what we want Sky Squadron to be!

Remember, Sky Squadron is out on early access for Steam, and the demo is on the Meta Quest (search “Sky Squadron Beta” on the Meta Quest store!)

Happy flying pilots!

notes.title: Hotfix for Recentering on Vive/Index
notes.notes:
Hey Pilots!

We've had some reports of recentering not working for some users, so we've just pushed up a hotfix that should (hopefully) fix it. We presently don't have access to an Index/Vive to test the solution, so please let us know if you're still having issues.

There is a new "out of bounds" detector, that will detect when you've strayed too far for the cockpit, and pop up a message prompting you telling you how to fix the view.

We may be a little unresponsive over the holiday break, but be aware we are listening, and will be back on in full force in the new year.

Remember you can always join our discord to chat with us directly!

notes.title: Playtest Update - Sky Squadron Goes Flat!
notes.notes:
No VR headset? 😔
No wukkas! 😀

Sky Squadron is launching on a flat screen near you! 

This ripper update includes:


 Full gameplay support without VR.
 Choose your weapon: play with either keyboard/mouse or controller.
 A brand new mission to take down the A.I. Core!

So got mates who would like to join the Squadron but don't own a VR headset?
Let them know to join our playtest to access this feature!

notes.title: Playtest Update - Mission 2 Train Miniboss!
notes.notes:
G'day Test Pilots! 🐨

We've got some more bonza news for ya' in an update that's just gone live. You'll now be able to take on the challenging new train miniboss in Mission 2 as part of the Playtest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38707470/2409b16fa20d2d3931e0abf1fe9e61b680673b5b.png

This is probably the most difficult segment of the game yet, with a tonne of hazards and projectiles to keep you on your toes. Please be sure to leave some feedback for us and whether you found it too easy/too difficult. We'd love to hear from you!

Reach us over on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/pwTaSNQ 
Or leave a comment or post in our Steam community.
